name: Digest · generate + prioritize
goal: The digest tick as one named chain: prune stale items, pull the two sources this install has (search headlines for the operator's topics, the calendar look-ahead), then score the fresh cards so the brief reads most-relevant first. Same pass the :30 cron runs; also runnable manually or by Nyo via run_workflow.

name: Digest · prioritize signals
goal: Score every unread, unscored digest card of a scored kind (0-100 + reason, plugin-digest-signal-priority rubric): cards worth acting on rise to high urgency, background noise sinks. Fires after digest generation; also runnable manually or by Nyo via run_workflow.

name: Digest · learn from dismissals
goal: The consideration layer's learn pass: harvest recently dismissed-not-starred items, distill avoid-patterns through the llm gateway, and append them to the plugin-digest-interests note the scorer reads. No-op below the new-dismissals threshold, so it is safe on every cron tick.
